permissions.reason: Browse R results and preview PNG plots and CSV tables in the selected pane's project.

contributions.title: Activate R workspace in this tab
contributions.text: Dock an editor above the selected local or Relay SSH R console. Reuses its existing editor, preserves other panes, and never starts R or executes code. Local consoles must report a working directory. Use Results in the editor for saved plots, tables and environment snapshots.

contributions.title: R plots and tables
contributions.text: Browse result folders in this pane's project. Open PNG plots and bounded CSV table previews produced by the Relay R companion.

contributions.title: R companion setup
contributions.text: In the R editor, use R setup to request approval to load the bundled companion into the existing idle R console. Refresh R session before running code. Every execution needs native approval; Results shows saved completion receipts, plots, tables and environment names. Requires jsonlite and PNG graphics support. Loading the plugin never starts R or installs packages. Installed-app acceptance remains pending.
